languageDesc: Choose the display language for the app
portableStartupDesc: Run at startup requires the installed version of Kudu.
portableUpdatesDesc: Portable builds use manual updates. Close Kudu and replace the app files with the latest portable download. Your settings are retained.
minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep running in system tray when closed
showNotificationsDesc: Display a notification when operations complete
threatDetectionAlertsDesc: Show a system notification when suspicious network activity is detected
autoRestartDesc: Restart automatically when an update is downloaded
updateCheckIntervalDesc: How often to check for updates in the background
softwareUpdaterNotificationsDesc: Check for third-party app updates in the background and show badge counts in the sidebar. You can still check manually from the Software Updater page.
preferElevatedLaunchDesc: Prompt for elevation when Kudu starts without admin rights (UAC on Windows, polkit on Linux). Off by default.
windowsPackageManagerDesc: Choose which package manager to use for software updates
cloudUnlinkedCardDesc: Unlock threat monitoring, AI safety scores, vulnerability scanning, and more
cloudLinkedCardDesc: Manage your cloud connection and device settings
backupFolderDesc: Where Kudu writes registry and shell-extension backups before making changes. Existing backups stay in their previous location when you switch folders.
backupFolderUpdatedDesc: Existing backups remain in their previous location.
backupModeDesc: Targeted only saves the keys being changed (small). Full hive snapshots entire branches before each run (hundreds of MB).
protectRecycleBinDesc: Skip the Recycle Bin during cleaning so accidentally deleted files can still be recovered
secureDeleteDesc: Overwrite files before deletion for sensitive data (slower)
closeBrowsersDesc: Automatically close browsers to unlock cache files
createRestorePointDesc: Create a system restore point before cleaning (requires admin)
keepDeletionLogLabel: Keep a log of deleted files
keepDeletionLogDesc: Record every deleted path so past cleanups can be reviewed from Scan History. The log lives in your Kudu data folder and clearing Scan History clears it too.
skipRecentFilesDesc: Don't delete files modified within this time
supportKuduDescription: Help fund continued open-source development and keep Kudu's desktop tools free for everyone.
startupSettingFailedDesc: Task Scheduler may be restricted by group policy or security software.
customFoldersDescription: Save a specific cache, temp, or log folder on any local drive. Scan it here and review its files before cleaning.
customFoldersWarning: Only add folders whose contents you know are disposable. Every regular file inside is a candidate; Kudu does not decide whether it is safe to delete. Custom folders are manual only and are not included in scheduled or Clean All actions.
customFolderPathPlaceholder: Choose a folder or enter its full absolute path
customFoldersEmptyDescription: Add a custom cache, temp, or log folder to scan and clean.
customFolderRecovery: Some files could not be moved to Trash or restored to their original location. They are preserved here for manual recovery:
customFolderLimited: This preview is partial because some folders were inaccessible, changed, or reached a scan limit. Only the listed files can be selected.
customFolderNoFiles: No eligible files found. Linked, excluded, and inaccessible entries are skipped.
customFolderConfirmDescription: Move {{count}} selected files ({{size}}) from this folder to the OS Trash. Close the app that uses these files first. Files changed since the scan will be skipped.
customFolderTrashSummary: {{count}} files moved to Trash · {{skipped}} skipped. Rescan to review skipped files.
themeDesc: Follow your system appearance or choose a mode

mac.title: Mac tools
mac.description: Inspect your Mac and apply targeted repairs or profiles.

help.spotlight: Read the indexing state, then request a rebuild for the startup disk or a mounted local volume. Reindexing continues in the background and can take time.
help.associations: Rebuild the list of registered applications and file associations for this account. Default opening applications may need to be selected again.
help.path: Analyze a shell configuration, review missing or duplicate entries, and reorder the proposed PATH. Only standalone literal PATH assignments can be edited. Changes apply to new terminal sessions.
help.battery: Read the battery charge, cycle count, capacity and estimated time remaining. Some sensors may be unavailable on your model or macOS version.
help.energy: Economy sets display sleep to 5 minutes and system sleep to 15, with Low Power Mode on battery when supported. Balanced uses 10 and 30 minutes. Restore returns the settings saved before your first profile.
help.animations: Choose faster or reduced Dock and window animations. Kudu saves the original values for restoration. Dock restarts after applying a profile; window preferences apply to newly opened windows.
help.audit: Generate a local HTML report with storage charts and system, application, startup, network and security information. Review the section summary before choosing where to save it.

confirm.spotlight: Enable Spotlight indexing and rebuild the selected volume’s index. macOS may request administrator authorization. Indexing can take time.
confirm.associations: Rebuild application associations for this account. Some default opening applications may need to be chosen again.
confirm.energy: Apply the selected energy profile or restore saved settings. macOS will request administrator authorization.
confirm.animations: Apply the selected animation profile or restore saved settings. Dock will restart and window changes apply to new windows.
confirm.path: Save a backup, then replace the reviewed PATH assignments with the proposed values. The changes apply to new terminals.
confirm.restorePath: Restore the shell configuration saved before your last correction, provided the file has not subsequently been edited.
